support.row_description: Ask us anything, or report a problem
support.title: Help & Support
support.empty_body: When you send us a request it shows up here, with our replies.
support.step1_title: What do you need help with?
support.record_hint: Tap to record a voice note (up to 5 minutes)
support.voice_too_short: That recording was too short. Record at least 3 seconds.
support.voice_failed: Recording didn't work. Check microphone access and try again.
support.step3_hint: Optional. Up to {{max}} photos or screenshots.
support.photos_permission: Photo access is needed to add screenshots. Turn it on in Settings.
support.too_many_screenshots: You can add up to {{max}} screenshots.
support.screenshot_too_large: One screenshot was over 10 MB and was left out.
support.device_note: We'll include app version {{app}}, {{device}}, {{os}} and the screen you came from. We don't send your location.
support.send_failed: We couldn't send your request. Nothing was lost. Try again.
support.sent_banner: Sent. We usually reply within a day. You'll get a notification when we answer.
support.thread_not_found: We couldn't find this request. It may belong to another account.
support.thread_empty: Your request is with us. We'll reply here.
support.thread_resolved_body: Reply here if anything's still wrong. This reopens your request.
support.thread_closed_body: This request is closed. Closed requests can't be reopened.
support.product_passed_body: This needs a change to the app. We'll tell you here when it's fixed.
support.reply_failed: Your message wasn't sent. Tap Send to try again.
support.reply_closed: This request is closed. Start a new request and we'll pick it up.
support.not_uploaded: A screenshot didn't finish uploading. Remove it, add it again and send.
